name: Hana Sakuragi
source:
Likes: her friends and family, chocolate, cooking 
Dislikes: bitter melon, bothering people close to her with her personal issues

The player character of « Doki Doki 5 » an otome game produced by Mikona.
A college student, she is a sweet girl who is still not over from a heartbreak. However, she feels safe to be able to rely on her two best friends: Natsume and Kou.
